New in this build:
- SAMPLER: every control now changes the sound, including the ENVELOPE, LFO and filter pages. Tap the envelope graph once to add a point, double tap a point to delete it. MISC page: Levels offsets, Polyphony (MAX, SLIDE, Porta, Mono), Time, Tracking, Group, arpeggiator, echo delay and a C3 to C7 keyboard.
- Arpeggiator chord "Auto (sustain)" latches: it keeps running after you let go, and stops when the transport stops or the arp is turned off.
- Live waveform with a playback cursor; SAMPLE / ENVELOPE / MISC tabs are physical buttons; track REV plays again.
- Piano roll reaches C1 to C8.
- Accent colours follow the mode: red in Platinum and Modern, yellow in Vintage, blue in Texture.
- Track menu crash fixed, and the track menu is in a new order.
Please try: open a track's sample editor, turn the envelope and LFO knobs while it plays, then set the arp to Auto and play a chord. If MAX + doesn't respond, drag the sampler window up by its title bar.
